title: Metformin
subtitle: Uses, mechanisms, benefits, side effects, interactions, monitoring, and safety related to metformin.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from multiple clinical trials supports metformin’s use in type 2 diabetes management. Emerging research suggests additional benefits in weight management and metabolic health. Some safety concerns are well documented, while rare adverse effects require careful clinical judgment. Ongoing studies explore novel uses and mechanisms.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
